## Dependency assurance

- [ ] This PR uses committed lock/checksum files and reproducible installs.
- [ ] Major/runtime/API/database changes include migration and rollback notes.
- [ ] Tests, typecheck, lint, build, security scans, and dependency review pass.
- [ ] New dependencies have verified source, maintenance, license, and install-script behavior.
- [ ] Production-impacting changes have staging/canary validation and an owner.
